name: Summon Dragon

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: an object bearing a dragon's image worth 500+ GP

targets.description: an unoccupied space you can see within range

upcast.text: Use the slot level in the stat block: higher slots give the spirit more Hit Points, AC and attacks.

summary: Call a Draconic spirit that bites, claws and breathes on your foes.
text: It uses the Draconic Spirit stat block, shares your Initiative and takes its turn right after yours, obeying your commands. Its stats grow with the slot level.
